root.description: The id of the root the paths are under

config.description: The demanded config, relative to its root

member.description: A config reachable from `config` through `references` edges, `config` itself included

distance.description: The length of the shortest `references` path from `config` to `member`; 0 for the config itself

projection-tsconfig-closure.description: A row of the derived `tsconfig_closure` relation
